finalText:
All 625 cases pass and `verify.js` confirms it.

The bug: `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js` computed tax on the pre-discount amount (`cents * taxRate`) instead of taxing the discounted total, and added two independently-rounded numbers instead of rounding once at the end. Fixed by taxing the already-discounted, already-rounded amount: `applyTax(discounted, taxRate)`.
